name: Heavy Metal Index — open data catalog
description: Machine-readable source observations and regulatory limits from the Heavy Metal Index, with provenance and measurement qualifications.

license.structured_data: EU sui generis database rights reserved (Directive 96/9/EC). Free to read and cite single records; systematic/bulk extraction or commercial re-utilisation requires a licence — see https://heavymetalindex.com/licensing

attribution: Heavy Metal Index (heavymetalindex.com), operated by the Institute of Contaminant Standards. Cite the page_url or wiki_doi carrying each value.

datasets.name: Heavy Metal Index — food & ingredient occurrence data
datasets.description: Source-linked ingredient and analyte data with measurement and provenance information where available. Source-specific findings are linked from each canonical ingredient page. Values retain their stated measurement basis.

datasets.name: Heavy Metal Index — regulatory limit corpus
datasets.description: Published maximum-level / regulatory-limit records for heavy metals in food and consumer-product matrices across jurisdictions, with agency, program, matrix, effective and sunset dates, and the source page carrying each rule.

datasets.name: Heavy Metal Index — source corpus DOI locator
datasets.description: A DOI → source-page map for the Heavy Metal Index corpus: every peer-reviewed and regulatory document with a resolvable DOI that has a live source page, keyed by bare lowercased DOI, with the page slug, public evidence tier, and year. Lets any client resolve a DOI to its record on heavymetalindex.com/sources/{slug}. Document titles are carried in the companion sources.csv.
